name: DS Cluster S44: Ticker Prefix Convention (Bare Tickers)
description: Tests: reference_stocks, reference_futures, fx_pairs, crypto_pairs, indices all accept bare tickers. is_asset_ref also uses bare tickers. Compiler auto-resolves from asset database.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S44: Ticker Prefix Convention
# =============================================================================
# S44 rules: All free-text ticker transforms accept BARE tickers — no prefix.
#   reference_stocks(ticker="SPY")    — stocks: bare
#   reference_futures(ticker="ES")   — futures: bare
#   fx_pairs(ticker="EURUSD")        — FX: bare (system handles DB lookup)
#   crypto_pairs(ticker="BTCUSD")   — crypto: bare
#   indices(ticker="SPX")            — indices: bare
# Compiler checks against asset DB and auto-resolves bare tickers.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === STOCKS: bare ticker ===
qqq = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
qqq_close = qqq.c

# === FUTURES: bare ticker ===
es = reference_futures(ticker="ES")()
es_close = es.c

# === FX: bare ticker ===
eurusd = fx_pairs(ticker="EURUSD")()
eur_close = eurusd.c

# === CRYPTO: bare ticker ===
btc = crypto_pairs(ticker="BTCUSD")()
btc_close = btc.c

# === INDICES: bare ticker ===
spx = indices(ticker="SPX")()
spx_close = spx.c

# === is_asset_ref: also bare ===
is_spy = is_asset_ref(ticker="SPY")()
spy_only = where(is_spy, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Multi-Asset Reference (all bare tickers)',
    category='Ticker Convention',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='QQQ', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, qqq_close))

xy_lines(
    title='FX: EURUSD (bare ticker)',
    category='Ticker Convention',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EURUSD', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=eur_close)

xy_lines(
    title='Crypto: BTCUSD (bare ticker)',
    category='Ticker Convention',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTCUSD', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=btc_close)

xy_lines(
    title='Index: SPX (bare ticker)',
    category='Ticker Convention',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPX', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spx_close)
